Tree

Trees organize nested data such as file systems, org charts, and permission scopes. Combine node rows, toggles, icons, and checkboxes for browsable hierarchies.

Basic Tree

Wrap the hierarchy in .zak-tree using .zak-tree-node and .zak-node-row.

Products
Electronics
Laptops
Phones
Accessories
Cables
HTML
<div class="zak-tree">
  <div class="zak-tree-node zak-open">
    <div class="zak-node-row">Products</div>
    <div class="zak-tree-children">
      <div class="zak-tree-node">
        <div class="zak-node-row">Electronics</div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
document.querySelectorAll('#toggle-tree .zak-toggle').forEach(function (btn) {
  btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
    var node = btn.closest('.zak-tree-node');
    var open = node.classList.toggle('zak-open');
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
  });
});

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-treeRoot container for the hierarchy
.zak-tree-nodeA single node (can nest children)
.zak-tree-node.openExpanded state — shows children
.zak-node-rowHorizontal label row of a node
.zak-tree-childrenWrapper for nested child nodes
.zak-toggleExpand/collapse control button

Accessibility

  • Mark the tree container with role="tree" and items with role="treeitem" when JS behavior is applied.
  • Each toggle button needs aria-expanded and a label; focus should move predictably with arrow keys in full implementations.
  • Keep label text directly next to checkboxes so label association is trivial.
  • Visual indentation must be preserved for screen readers via nesting or aria-level.
  • Do not make the whole row a link and a toggle simultaneously unless nesting clearly separates the interactive regions.
